say:2:1029117001:2.text: How'd you get rid of the Hypofiends with your eyes closed the whole time? There's no way you could see!
say:2:1029117001:2.source_cn: 你的眼睛一直闭着，是看不到吗？你竟然还准确地清除了魔物？

say:3:1029117002:1.text: Do not worry; I'm not blind.

say:4:1029117003:1.text: Well, it doesn't matter. Lord Syriosus would have come to help, even if you hadn't stepped in!
say:4:1029117003:1.source_cn: 你说话怎么又慢又怪的……无所谓，就算你刚刚没有出手，赛...

say:6:1029117005:1.text: How can you be so dull? Just by hearing such a dashing name, you should know that Lord Syriosus must be a Hypogean!
say:6:1029117005:1.source_cn: 你怎么这么迟钝。听这个帅气的名字叫就知道，赛利欧斯大人...

say:7:1029117006:1.text: A Hypogean? I've never heard of him.

say:8:1029117007:1.text: Pff, of course you haven't, because I just made it up—I mean, a higher being informed me!
say:8:1029117007:1.source_cn: 哼哼，你当然没听过，因为是他们瞎编——不对，是我接收到...

say:9:1029117008:1.text: Hypogeans... offer no information or guidance to mortals.
say:9:1029117008:1.source_cn: 恶魔……不会给予人类指引。

say:10:1029117009:1.text: W-what are you saying?! Of course they do! Are you calling me a liar?
say:10:1029117009:1.source_cn: 你、你乱说什么呢！恶魔就是会这样的，我肯定比你更懂恶魔好吧！

say:12:1029117010:1.text: Uh, excuse me... Why are you here, Archon Scarlita?
say:12:1029117010:1.source_cn: 那个，打断一下。半神斯克嘉莉德大人，您为何在此处？

say:13:1029117011:1.text: I was just passing through and saw the Hypofiends attacking this child.
say:13:1029117011:1.source_cn: 我，并非特意来到此处，路过而已。魔物攻击她，必须消灭——

say:14:1029117012:1.text: I see. Well, this girl is Dora. We were actually looking for her!
say:14:1029117012:1.source_cn: 原来如此，这个小女孩是朵拉，我们就是来寻找她的！

say:15:1029117013:1.text: That is good, for this place is dangerous. Dora, Hypogeans never offer guidance to humans, only temptation. Be on your guard. Farewell, everyone.
say:15:1029117013:1.source_cn: 如此甚好，此地危险。朵拉，恶魔从不指引人类，唯有诱惑，...
